description: This Java source file contains an immutable implementation of the DeleteAttributeLiveCommand interface, responsible for representing a command to delete an attribute in a live signal modification context within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable, final class implementing DeleteAttributeLiveCommand, representing a command to delete an attribute on a live signal.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method creating a new instance of DeleteAttributeLiveCommandImpl from a Command object, cast to DeleteAttribute.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the attribute to be deleted.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with the specified DittoHeaders set.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization; returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Creates and returns a response builder for the command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object for debugging.
